inputs.text: 현재 시각, 백령면·대청면에 실제 경계경보 발령. 경보 미수신 지역은 자체적으로 실제 경계경보를 발령

requested_area.areaDesc: Baengnyeong-myeon and Daecheong-myeon, Ongjin-gun, Incheon (area named in the ministry's alert)

fields.description: A real civil defence alert (경계경보) is now in effect for Baengnyeong-myeon and Daecheong-myeon, Ongjin-gun, Incheon. This is not a drill. No end time has been given.
fields.headline: Civil defence alert in effect for Baengnyeong-myeon and Daecheong-myeon, Ongjin-gun
fields.instruction: Get ready to go to the nearest shelter now and follow official instructions. Help children and older people go first.
left_out: The line telling areas that did not receive the alert to issue an actual alert themselves was left out. It is an instruction to authorities, not a fact for the public.
The cause of the alert and an end time were not included because the input does not state them.
fields.note_for_reviewer: The input does not name the threat, so the instruction uses standard 경계경보 guidance and should be checked before release. Seoul Metropolitan Government is the issuer, but the alert area is in Incheon. Please confirm that Seoul should issue this, and that the ministry's line about non-receiving areas was not meant to trigger a Seoul-wide alert.
